name: animated-shorts
description: Cartoon 3D story shorts (three.js inside Remotion), made with the cartoon-3d-short skill

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts ScorchShort out/scorch_1080p.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --gl angle
scripts.render:2k: remotion render src/index.ts ScorchShort out/scorch_2k.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --scale 1.3333 --gl angle
scripts.render:test: remotion render src/index.ts ScorchShort out/scorch_test.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 --gl angle --frames 0-149
